course_name_original: Creación de Empresas de Base Tecnológica
prerequisites: It is preferable that students have already passed the first-year course "Empresa".
It is preferable that students have passed several technology-related courses directly linked to the future exercise of their profession.

learning_outcomes.text: Integrate and give a commercial vision to knowledge from other technological subjects.
Put into practice interpersonal skills related to teamwork (leadership, communication, group management, negotiation...) in any professional activity.
Relate with real external agents to the University (suppliers, clients, financial entities...) and know the organisms and instruments of support for entrepreneurs.
Promote an entrepreneurial spirit in any professional activity.
Put into practice business communication techniques.
Capacity for organization and planning in the field of business, and other institutions and organizations.
Know and apply basic elements of economics and human resource management, project organization and planning, as well as legislation, regulation and standardization in telecommunications.

Ability to work in a multidisciplinary group and in a multilingual environment and to communicate, both in writing and orally, knowledge, procedures, results and ideas related to telecommunications and electronics.

syllabus_topics: Creation of companies: the business plan and technology
Generalities: objectives, methodology and work plan of the subject.
The process of creating a technological micro-company: market study and business plan.
Environment to study, approach of the study and instruments.
Income statements (or profit and loss) and cash flow statements (or receipts and payments).

assessment_methods.method: Group project report on company creation (PLAN_EMPRESA)
Final exam: final presentation of the group project and colloquium (EXA_FIN)

assessment_rules: For ordinary assessment, a minimum attendance of 75% is required. The final grade is calculated as: NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA x 0.5 + EXA_FIN x 0.3 + PA x 0.2. To pass, the final grade must be at least 5 points. If minimum attendance is not met, the grade will be 'No Presentado'. For extraordinary assessment, the final grade is calculated as: NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA_EXTRA x 0.6 + EXA_EXTRA x 0.4. To pass, the final grade must be at least 5 points. Students for extraordinary assessment must inform the professor at least 4 weeks prior to the exam date and submit the definitive business plan 48 hours before the exam.
